what_happened: The first test-cache build failed immediately with ValueError: unsupported T1ce/WT row schema 'aflow.brats2024.random_subject_train_test_split'. The sealed test manifest uses the outer split schema (modalities.t1c + seg_path) rather than the inner split's image_path/label_path contract.
no_test_data_was_read: The failure occurred inside validate_row, which runs before _load_canonical_nifti. No test image or label NIfTI was opened. Only manifest rows were parsed, and the manifest byte SHA was already bound by the original freeze.
fix: scripts/build_t1ce_wt_cache.py now normalizes any non-inner-split row through _whole_volume_training_row imported from scripts/evaluate_sammed3d_t1ce_wt_checkpoint.py, i.e. the same already-validated adapter the frozen evaluator uses for test rows. No path or label mapping was re-derived independently.
